summary:
• llama.cpp — a portable C/C++ library for running large language models locally, now stable at version 1.0 enabling private on‑prem AI applications.
• Gemini Config Checker — a lightweight web UI that validates Google AI Studio proxy access by mimicking a signed‑in user, providing reliable connectivity signals.
• Claude Code — a VS Code extension that assists coding with Claude, adding a spinner, security patch, and inline policy hints for smoother, safer notebook workflows.
• Datasette MapLibre — a Datasette plugin that adds interactive vector maps using MapLibre GL and free tiles, enabling browser‑only geospatial visualisation without external services.
• Datasette Apps — an HTML/JS app framework for Datasette that now supports URL‑fragment linking and automatic agent suggestions, turning separate apps into a cohesive dashboard.
• Blackwell GPU Forensic Study — analysis of model weight patterns proving Chinese AI labs trained recent models on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, highlighting export‑control circumvention risks.
